cohort: 50 SARS-CoV-2-positive women who delivered at the study institute
finding: Pregnancy complications, preterm labor, and COVID-19 severity were not higher than in screen-negative pregnant women, and no vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 was reported; most women had a positive birth experience.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was 38%, and all cesarean deliveries were done only for obstetric or fetal indications.
